# json/prettier-compat samples

Source: Prettier, `tests/format/json/json/__snapshots__/format.test.js.snap`
(<https://github.com/prettier/prettier/tree/main/tests/format/json/json>), the entries for
`multi-line.json`, `single-line.json` and `key-value.json` with the `json` parser, default options
(`printWidth: 80`). Input and output are copied from the snapshot.

Not covered: Prettier's `fill` layout of number arrays and its number normalization
(`docs/formatting/presets.md`).
